My name... well, I am just an old woman with my small piece of land here in SNNP. This little plot of 0.06 hectares has my enset and some fruit trees, with coffee growing between them. I have no money for chemical fertilizer — and even if I did, the cooperative bring it late and my plot is so small. I put the cattle manure and ash from my cooking fire on the enset, that is what my mother taught me. I work this land myself with my hands, no oxen needed for such a small garden plot, and I do not have money to pay anyone to help me.
